editorial: Imagine sandstorms dancing to a thousand-voice choir, pulling you into a universe that feels as vast as your own imagination. The film treats the desert not just as a backdrop but as an active, almost sentient character that shifts your expectations at every turn. Timothée Chalamet delivers a quiet, almost relentless intensity that keeps the epic grounded, a pulse you’ll carry long after the credits roll. You will be matched to the film’s reflective tension if you thrive on complex pathways that weave destiny with choice in a way that feels both relentless and tender. However, the sprawling escalation sometimes stretches the narrative threads a little too thin at the mid-point, leaving you yearning for a tighter focus.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
